title: Task

task_params.description: Parameters applied to all matching rows (specific to `task_type`). See project.createTask.

filter_type.description: Type of filter defining the rows that the task is applied to

filter_params.description: Parameters defining the rows that the task is applied to (specific to `filter_type`). See project.createTask.

time_created.description: Time the task was created in Telerivet

time_active.description: Time Telerivet started executing the task

time_complete.description: Time Telerivet finished executing the task

total_rows.description: The total number of rows matching the filter (null if not known)

current_row.description: The number of rows that have been processed so far

status.description: The current status of the task

error_message.description: Error message if the task failed

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this task. Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

table_id.description: ID of the data table this task is applied to (if applicable)

user_id.description: ID of the Telerivet user who created the task (if applicable)

project_id.description: ID of the project this task belongs to
